items.title: Handmade Indian Cotton Dress | Burgundy Leaf Block Print | Sustainable Artisan Label | M/L
items.description:
Beautiful handmade dress in brown colour with a cream leaf motif, which is a classic Indian block-print style. Handcrafted in Delhi by Anoshka Boutique, a homegrown label known for artisan-made, tailor-stitched pieces. Made from soft, breathable natural cotton, perfect for summer days.
Details:
Sleeveless A-line cut with a rounded neckline
Flattering, relaxed fit that skims the body
Side button detail
Hand block-printed leaf pattern
Natural cotton, sustainable and breathable

Note: cotton naturally creases (as shown) — a quick iron or steam and it's ready to go.
Size: M/L 
This best suits a bust of roughly 38 inch / 96 cm or smaller for a comfortable fit. I’m a 40 inch bust and it is very slightly snug on me there, which is the only reason I’m selling. Everything else fits lovely and loose. The A-line body is generous through the waist and hips.
Condition: Excellent

items.title: Indian Tunic Top | Peplum | Tie At Back | Size L
items.description:
Lovely sleeveless cotton tunic top in a deep brown, covered in a geometric and floral print in cream, a palette and design with an Indian block-print.
Made from lightweight, breathable pure cotton, soft, airy and perfect for summer days or layering.
Details:
Sleeveless with rounded neckline
Gathered peplum waist that falls into a soft, floaty A-line
Back tie to adjust the fit
Delicate all-over floral geometric print
Lightweight pure cotton, slightly sheer, breathable
Fit guide:
This best suits a bust of roughly 38 inch / 96 cm or smaller for a comfortable fit. I’m a 40 inch bust and it’s very slightly snug on me there, which is the only reason I'm selling. The peplum waist and A-line body fall loose and floaty below, generous through the waist.
Easy to style with jeans, linen trousers or shorts. A pretty, versatile summer piece.

items.title: Indian Cotton Maxi Skirt · Kalamkari Floral Print · Elasticated Waist · Boho Summer
items.description:
Stunning full-length Indian cotton skirt in a rich kalamkari-style floral print in deep burgundy, rust, tan and cream on a dark base. Beautifully detailed and full of movement. Breathable cotton. 

Details:
Elasticated waist for a comfortable, adjustable fit
Full A-line / flared cut — lovely twirl and drape
Traditional Indian block-print floral pattern
Lightweight, breathable pure cotton
Earthy palette

Fits a waist of roughly 38–40 inch thanks to the elastic, and skims the hips beautifully (fits my 43 inch / 109 cm hips with ease). Perfect for summer, festivals or everyday boho style, pairs easily with a simple top and sandals.

items.title: Indian Cotton Summer Dress · Tribal Border Print · Asymmetric Hem · Size L
items.description:
Striking colour-block dress with a cream bodice and a tan skirt, finished with a bold navy tribal-style border print and a dramatic asymmetric pointed hem. Kimono-style sleeves, gold zip at the back and comes with pockets! Perfect Indian cotton summer. 

Size: L (label). Fits my measurements (bust 40 inch / 101 cm, waist 38 inch / 96 cm, hips 43 inch / 109 cm) but a bit tight for my tummy area. 
Condition: Excellent, wore twice

items.title: Indian Cotton Block-Print Summer Midi Dress | Green & Rust Red | Boho Ajrakh Style | Size L
items.description:
Beautiful handmade Indian block-print summer dress in classic green with a contrast deep-red, a traditional Indian design called Ajrakh. Made with breathable cotton, perfect for summer. Finished with a carved wooden button and a red tassel at the neckline for a lovely artisan touch.

Details:
Green with intricate floral/paisley block print
Contrasting red paisley yoke, cuffs and trim
Empire line with a gathered, flowing skirt
V-neckline with wooden button + red tassel detail
3/4 length sleeves with contrast cuffs
Breathable pure cotton
Size L
Condition: Excellent

items.title: Vintage Style Navy Bird Print Dress | Draped V-Neck | Zip | Pockets
items.description:
Beautiful navy dress covered in a charming vintage-style print of songbirds, blossom and branches in mustard, coral, teal and pink. A flattering draped surplice (wrap-look) V-neckline, softly pleated cap shoulders, an exposed gold front zip and a nipped waist give it a really elegant, put-together shape. A flattering dress, smart enough for events, work or dressing up, with a lovely feminine silhouette. The bird print makes it a real talking point.
Note: Fabric has a small tear but it’s almost never visible due to the folds and the color.

Details:
Deep navy with colourful bird-and-branch print
Draped V-neckline
Structured, softly padded cap shoulders
Exposed gold zip feature down the front
Fitted waist with pleated tulip skirt
Side pockets

items.title: Indian Block Print Cotton Tote Bag | Handmade | Beach Bag
items.description:
Beautiful handmade cotton tote bag from India, in a classic hand block-printed paisley design. Deep red, indigo blue and sage green on a natural cream base, with a pretty printed border. Perfect as an everyday shopper, book bag, beach bag or market tote. Folds away easily and adds a pop of pattern. A lovely artisan piece.

Details:
Sturdy block-printed cotton canvas
Spacious tote/shopper shape
Double shoulder-length handles
Traditional paisley + floral block print
Unlined, lightweight but roomy
Handmade

Condition: Very Good, used.
